chunks: Ali ibn Isma'il, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Regarding the young girl who has not yet had her first menstruation and has not reached puberty, if a man buys her, he said: There is no waiting period (istibra') upon her; he may consummate the marriage with her immediately.
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a slave girl who hasn't reached puberty?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies that a pre-pubescent slave girl does not require a waiting period (istibra') to confirm pregnancy, as her biological state is already known. Consequently, the owner may consummate the union immediately upon purchase, distinguishing this ruling from that of adult women who must undergo a menstrual cycle or childbirth to establish lineage. This ruling underscores the Shia juristic emphasis on biological certainty in determining paternity within the context of slavery.
